const CSS = `
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Playfair+Display:wght@900&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');
  :root { --fire1:#FF4500;--fire2:#FF8C00;--gold:#FFB800;--gold2:#FFD700;--dark:#0F0500;--dark2:#1A0800;--dark3:#2A1000;--cream:#FFF3DC;--white:#fff;--gray:#9a7a5a;--green:#25D366;--red:#e53e3e; }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
  body{background:var(--dark);padding-bottom:68px;}
  .app{min-height:100vh;background:var(--dark);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--cream);overflow-x:hidden;}
  .fire-bg{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:120%;height:380px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center bottom,rgba(255,69,0,0.15) 0%,rgba(255,140,0,0.06) 40%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
  @keyframes flicker{0%{transform:scale(1) rotate(-2deg);}100%{transform:scale(1.08) rotate(2deg);filter:brightness(1.2);}}
  @keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}50%{transform:translateY(-5px);}}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,184,0,0.4);}50%{box-shadow:0 0 36px rgba(255,184,0,0.8);}}
  @keyframes slideIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}

  .hdr{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0%,var(--dark2) 100%);border-bottom:2px solid var(--fire1);padding:0 18px;height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;box-shadow:0 4px 28px rgba(255,69,0,0.3);}
  .logo-wrap{cursor:pointer;user-select:none;}
  .logo{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:22px;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 rgba(255,69,0,0.5),-2px -2px 0 rgba(255,215,0,0.3);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2) 0%,var(--fire2) 60%,var(--fire1) 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;letter-spacing:4px;line-height:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,140,0,0.5));}
  .logo-sub{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;opacity:0.6;}
  .hdr-right{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;}
  .cart-pill{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:50px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;transition:all 0.2s;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(255,69,0,0.35);}
  .cart-pill:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}
  .cbadge{background:var(--dark);color:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;width:18px;height:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold);}
  .ghost-pill{background:rgba(255,184,0,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,184,0,0.3);color:var(--gold);border-radius:50px;padding:7px 13px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;}

  .bottom-nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:64px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--dark2),#000);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,69,0,0.22);display:flex;z-index:150;box-shadow:0 -4px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);}
  .nav-btn{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;position:relative;}
  .nav-btn .ni{font-size:20px;transition:transform 0.2s;}
  .nav-btn .nl{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--gray);transition:color 0.2s;}
  .nav-btn.on .nl{color:var(--gold);}
  .nav-btn.on .ni{transform:scale(1.15);}
  .nav-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:20%;right:20%;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--fire1),var(--gold));border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.2s;}
  .nav-btn.on::after{opacity:1;}
  .nav-notif{position:absolute;top:6px;right:20%;background:var(--fire1);color:white;border-radius:50%;width:14px;height:14px;font-size:8px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}

  .hero{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1a0400 0%,#3d1200 30%,#1a0400 70%,#000 100%);padding:28px 20px 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,140,0,0.2);}
  .hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%,rgba(255,69,0,0.18) 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%,rgba(255,140,0,0.08) 0%,transparent 60%);}
  .hero-left{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .hero-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:42px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2) 0%,var(--fire2) 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
  .hero-addr{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,200,120,0.65);margin-top:5px;font-weight:600;}
  .hours-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:rgba(255,184,0,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,184,0,0.25);color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:30px;margin-top:8px;}
  .hero-flames{font-size:50px;position:relative;z-index:1;animation:flicker 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
  .info-bar{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.55);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,69,0,0.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:20px;padding:9px 20px;font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .info-bar a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;}
  .info-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}

  .dbanner{position:relative;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,69,0,0.13),rgba(255,140,0,0.07));border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.28);margin:12px 18px;border-radius:14px;padding:13px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
  .dbicon{font-size:26px;animation:bounce 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .dbanner p{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);}
  .dbanner small{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);display:block;margin-top:2px;}

  .loy-banner{position:relative;z-index:1;border-radius:14px;padding:13px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0 18px 12px;overflow:hidden;}
  .loy-banner.prog{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,140,0,0.09),rgba(255,69,0,0.05));border:1px solid rgba(255,140,0,0.2);}
  .loy-banner.win{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,215,0,0.14),rgba(255,140,0,0.07));border:2px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(255,184,0,0.15);}
  .loy-banner::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--fire1),var(--gold),var(--fire2));}
  .loy-icon{font-size:24px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .loy-content{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .loy-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:2px;}
  .loy-bar-wrap{height:5px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.13);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:3px;}
  .loy-bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--fire1),var(--gold));transition:width 0.6s ease;}
  .loy-count{font-size:9px;color:var(--gray);text-align:right;}
  .loy-claim-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));color:var(--dark);border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 12px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;transition:all 0.2s;}
  .loy-claim-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}

  .page-wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px 40px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .page-hero{padding:28px 20px 20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,140,0,0.15);}
  .page-hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1a0400,#3d1200 40%,#1a0400 80%,#000);}
  .page-hero-content{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .page-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:36px;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
  .page-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:4px;}

  .sec-div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:24px 0 14px;}
  .sec-div::before,.sec-div::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,140,0,0.35),transparent);}
  .sec-label{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;white-space:nowrap;}
  .sec-icon{font-size:18px;}

  .food-layout{display:flex;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px 32px;gap:24px;align-items:flex-start;position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .menu-col{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px;}

  .card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.25s;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.13);position:relative;}
  .card:hover{border-color:var(--fire2);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 36px rgba(255,69,0,0.22);}
  .card.soldout{opacity:0.55;cursor:not-allowed;}.card.soldout:hover{transform:none;box-shadow:none;border-color:rgba(255,100,0,0.13);}
  .card-img-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;height:150px;overflow:hidden;}
  .card-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform 0.3s;}
  .card:hover:not(.soldout) .card-img{transform:scale(1.06);}
  .card-img-wrap::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:55px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#1f0900);}
  .no-img{width:100%;height:150px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1f0900,#2a1000);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:48px;}
  .ctag{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:2;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;}
  .soldout-tag{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:2;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:10px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);color:var(--red);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--red);}
  .card-body{padding:12px 14px 14px;}
  .cname{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin-bottom:3px;color:var(--gold);line-height:1.1;}
  .cdesc{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .cfooter{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
  .cprice{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
  .addbtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:10px;width:32px;height:32px;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;transition:all 0.15s;}
  .addbtn:hover{transform:scale(1.15);}
  .addbtn:disabled{opacity:0.35;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;}

  .cart-col{width:280px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .cart-box{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0300,#1a0800);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.22);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;position:sticky;top:80px;max-height:calc(100vh - 150px);overflow-y:auto;}
  .cart-hd{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
  .cqbadge{font-size:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);padding:2px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--white);}
  .empty{text-align:center;padding:24px 0;color:#4a3020;font-size:12px;}
  .eicon{font-size:36px;display:block;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:0.45;}
  .ci{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.08);}
  .ci-name{flex:1;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--cream);line-height:1.3;}
  .ci-badge{font-size:8px;font-weight:700;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:8px;margin-left:3px;}
  .ci-badge.free{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));color:var(--dark);}
  .ci-badge.merch{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);color:var(--cream);}
  .ci-price{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--gold);min-width:38px;text-align:right;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold);}
  .qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
  .qb{background:rgba(255,100,0,0.13);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:5px;width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;transition:all 0.15s;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold);}
  .qb:hover{background:var(--fire1);-webkit-text-fill-color:white;}
  .qn{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--cream);min-width:10px;text-align:center;}
  .cdiv{border:none;border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,100,0,0.18);margin:12px 0;}
  .crow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:5px;}
  .crow.dr{color:var(--gold);}
  .ctotal{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px;margin-top:7px;align-items:center;}
  .ctlabel{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:18px;color:var(--cream);letter-spacing:2px;}
  .ctval{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
  .obtn{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:13px;padding:14px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:3px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(255,69,0,0.35);}
  .obtn:hover{transform:scale(1.02);}
  .obtn:disabled{opacity:0.35;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;}

  .merch-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(165px,1fr));gap:14px;}
  .m-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1a0900);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.13);transition:all 0.25s;position:relative;}
  .m-card:hover{border-color:var(--fire2);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 36px rgba(255,69,0,0.22);}
  .m-card-vis{height:155px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .m-card-vis.dark{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0d0d0d,#1a1a1a);}
  .m-card-vis.light{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2a2010,#1a1505);}
  .m-card-vis.orange{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2a1000,#1a0800);}
  .m-card-vis::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:50px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#1a0900);}
  .m-emoji{font-size:52px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 12px rgba(255,69,0,0.28));}
  .m-card-tag{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:2;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:20px;}
  .m-card-body{padding:12px 14px 14px;}
  .m-card-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--gold);line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:2px;}
  .m-card-color{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:10px;}
  .m-card-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
  .m-card-price{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
  .m-add-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:10px;width:32px;height:32px;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;transition:all 0.15s;}
  .m-add-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.15);}

  .m-detail-modal{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1a0600,#0d0300);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.3);border-radius:22px;padding:28px;max-width:400px;width:100%;position:relative;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;animation:slideIn 0.3s ease;}
  .m-detail-modal::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--fire1),var(--gold),var(--fire2));border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;}
  .m-detail-vis{height:170px;border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:16px;font-size:72px;}
  .m-detail-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .m-detail-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.6;}
  .m-detail-color{font-size:11px;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:14px;font-weight:600;}
  .size-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .sz-btn{padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.25);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.05);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;color:var(--gray);}
  .sz-btn.on{border-color:var(--fire1);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,69,0,0.2),rgba(255,140,0,0.1));color:var(--gold);}
  .m-detail-price{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:30px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .m-add-full{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:13px;padding:14px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:3px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;}

  .deals-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .deal-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,184,0,0.28);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;animation:slideIn 0.3s ease;}
  .deal-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--fire1),var(--gold),transparent);}
  .deal-emoji{font-size:36px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .deal-info{flex:1;}
  .deal-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:3px;}
  .deal-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:5px;}
  .deal-expires{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,140,0,0.6);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;}
  .deal-price-wrap{text-align:right;flex-shrink:0;}
  .deal-original{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);text-decoration:line-through;}
  .deal-deal{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
  .deal-free{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--green);-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--green);}
  .deal-save{font-size:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:white;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;margin-top:3px;display:inline-block;font-weight:700;}

  .review-form{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.2);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .review-form-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:12px;}
  .star-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .star-btn{font-size:24px;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;padding:0;transition:transform 0.15s;}
  .star-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.2);}
  .review-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
  .review-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.15);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;animation:slideIn 0.3s ease;}
  .review-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .review-name{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--cream);}
  .review-stars{font-size:14px;}
  .review-item{font-size:10px;color:var(--fire2);margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;}
  .review-text{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.6;}
  .review-date{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,100,0,0.3);margin-top:6px;}

  .profile-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.2);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .profile-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:14px;}
  .referral-box{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);border:1px solid rgba(255,184,0,0.2);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .referral-code{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:28px;letter-spacing:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
  .referral-sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:4px;}
  .copy-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:white;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 18px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:8px;}
  .order-hist-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.08);}
  .oh-ref{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:2px;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold);}
  .oh-info{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);}
  .oh-total{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:var(--cream);}
  .oh-status{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;}
  .oh-status.delivered{background:rgba(37,211,102,0.1);color:#25D366;}
  .oh-status.pending{background:rgba(255,140,0,0.1);color:var(--gold);}
  .loy-big-dots{display:flex;gap:7px;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0;}
  .loy-big-dot{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;transition:all 0.3s;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.04);}
  .loy-big-dot.done{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));border-color:var(--fire2);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,69,0,0.35);}
  .bday-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;}
  .bday-row input{flex:1;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.2);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 13px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.05);color:var(--cream);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12px;outline:none;}
  .bday-row input:focus{border-color:var(--fire2);}
  .save-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:white;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 14px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;}
  .bday-reward{background:rgba(255,184,0,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,184,0,0.3);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;}

  .overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);z-index:300;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);}
  .modal{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1a0600,#0d0300);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.3);border-radius:22px;padding:28px;max-width:420px;width:100%;position:relative;max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;animation:slideIn 0.3s ease;}
  .modal::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--fire1),var(--gold),var(--fire2));border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;}
  .m-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:28px;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .m-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:18px;}
  .type-sel{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .tbtn{flex:1;padding:9px 4px;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.04);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;text-align:center;color:var(--gray);}
  .tbtn.on{border-color:var(--fire1);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,69,0,0.18),rgba(255,140,0,0.08));color:var(--gold);}
  .zone-sel{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .zbtn{flex:1;padding:9px 6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.04);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;text-align:center;color:var(--gray);}
  .zbtn.on{border-color:var(--fire1);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,69,0,0.18),rgba(255,140,0,0.08));color:var(--gold);}
  .dnote{background:rgba(255,140,0,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,140,0,0.25);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:600;}
  .fg{margin-bottom:11px;}
  .fg label{display:block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .fg input,.fg select,.fg textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 13px;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.05);color:var(--cream);outline:none;transition:border 0.2s;resize:none;}
  .fg input::placeholder,.fg textarea::placeholder{color:#4a3020;}
  .fg input:focus,.fg select:focus,.fg textarea:focus{border-color:var(--fire2);}
  .fg select option{background:#1a0600;}
  .sec-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gray);margin:16px 0 9px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
  .sec-title::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.13);}
  .pay-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px;}
  .pay-card{border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 6px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.04);}
  .pay-card.on{border-color:var(--fire1);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,69,0,0.16),rgba(255,140,0,0.07));}
  .pay-card .pi{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:3px;}
  .pay-card .pn{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--gold);}
  .pay-card .ps{font-size:9px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:2px;}
  .eft-details{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.13);border-radius:9px;padding:11px;margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.9;}
  .eft-details strong{color:var(--cream);display:block;}
  .m-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;margin-top:18px;}
  .bbtn{flex:1;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:11px;padding:12px;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray);}
  .cbtn{flex:2;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:11px;padding:12px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;}
  .cbtn:hover{transform:scale(1.02);}
  .cbtn:disabled{opacity:0.3;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;}

  .sbox{text-align:center;}
  .sicon{font-size:56px;margin-bottom:12px;animation:flicker 1.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
  .stitle{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:34px;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;margin-bottom:7px;}
  .ssub{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.7;}
  .sref{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--dark),#1a0800);border:1px solid rgba(255,184,0,0.28);font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:6px;color:var(--gold);padding:11px 22px;border-radius:12px;display:inline-block;margin:13px 0 8px;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold);}
  .pay-confirm-box{background:rgba(255,140,0,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,140,0,0.22);border-radius:11px;padding:11px 14px;margin:10px 0;text-align:left;}
  .pay-confirm-box .pct{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:3px;}
  .pay-confirm-box .pcd{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.8;}
  .est-box{background:rgba(255,69,0,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,69,0,0.18);border-radius:11px;padding:9px 14px;margin:8px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
  .est-box .ei{font-size:20px;}
  .est-box .et{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--fire2);}
  .est-box .es{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);}
  .wabtn{margin-top:6px;background:var(--green);color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 22px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%;margin-bottom:6px;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;}
  .wabtn.drv{background:#128C7E;}
  .nbtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:11px;padding:12px 22px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer;width:100%;margin-top:4px;}
  .slogan{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:5px;color:rgba(255,140,0,0.22);margin-top:14px;display:block;}
  .loy-prog-card{background:rgba(255,100,0,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,140,0,0.18);border-radius:11px;padding:13px;margin-top:11px;}
  .loy-prog-hd{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:7px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;}
  .loy-prog-hd span{font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);letter-spacing:0;}
  .loy-dots{display:flex;gap:4px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:7px;}
  .loy-dot{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.16);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;transition:all 0.3s;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.03);}
  .loy-dot.done{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));border-color:var(--fire2);box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(255,69,0,0.3);}
  .loy-prog-msg{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);text-align:center;}
  .loy-unlock-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,215,0,0.12),rgba(255,140,0,0.07));border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.3);border-radius:11px;padding:13px;margin-top:11px;text-align:center;}
  .loy-unlock-card .lui{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:5px;display:block;}
  .loy-unlock-card .lut{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:3px;}
  .loy-unlock-card .lus{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);}

  .tracker-wrap{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 18px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .tracker-code{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:28px;letter-spacing:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;display:block;text-align:center;}
  .tracker-meta{text-align:center;margin-bottom:22px;font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);}
  .tracker-meta strong{color:var(--cream);}
  .live-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:rgba(255,69,0,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,69,0,0.2);border-radius:20px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:9px;color:var(--fire2);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px;}
  .live-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--fire1);animation:pulse 1.5s ease infinite;}
  .status-steps{position:relative;padding:0 8px;}
  .status-step{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:5px;}
  .step-left{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:40px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .step-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;transition:all 0.4s;border:2px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.13);background:rgba(255,100,0,0.04);}
  .step-icon.done{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));border-color:var(--fire2);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,69,0,0.28);}
  .step-icon.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));border-color:var(--gold);animation:pulse 1.5s ease infinite;}
  .step-line{flex:1;width:2px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.1);margin:3px 0;min-height:24px;transition:background 0.4s;}
  .step-line.done{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));}
  .step-right{padding:9px 0 22px;flex:1;}
  .step-label{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:rgba(255,200,120,0.28);transition:color 0.4s;}
  .step-label.done{color:var(--cream);}
  .step-label.active{color:var(--gold);}
  .step-desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:2px;}
  .step-desc.active{color:rgba(255,184,0,0.65);}
  .alert-card{border-radius:14px;padding:16px;text-align:center;animation:slideIn 0.4s ease;margin-top:16px;}
  .alert-card.onway{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(37,211,102,0.1),rgba(18,140,126,0.05));border:1px solid rgba(37,211,102,0.28);}
  .alert-card.ready{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,184,0,0.1),rgba(255,69,0,0.05));border:1px solid rgba(255,184,0,0.28);}
  .alert-card.done{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,215,0,0.1),rgba(255,69,0,0.05));border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.28);}
  .alert-icon{font-size:38px;display:block;margin-bottom:7px;animation:bounce 1s ease infinite;}
  .alert-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:3px;}
  .alert-card.onway .alert-title{color:#25D366;}
  .alert-card.ready .alert-title,.alert-card.done .alert-title{color:var(--gold);}
  .alert-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);}
  .last-updated{text-align:center;font-size:9px;color:rgba(255,100,0,0.3);margin-top:16px;letter-spacing:1px;}
  .track-input-page{max-width:360px;margin:36px auto;padding:18px;text-align:center;position:relative;z-index:1;}

  .staff-wrap{max-width:540px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .staff-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;text-align:center;}
  .staff-sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);text-align:center;margin-bottom:14px;margin-top:3px;}
  .staff-tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:14px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.05);border-radius:12px;padding:4px;}
  .staff-tab{flex:1;padding:8px 3px;border:none;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;color:var(--gray);}
  .staff-tab.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:var(--white);}
  .search-row{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-bottom:13px;}
  .search-row input{flex:1;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 13px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.05);color:var(--cream);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;outline:none;}
  .search-row input::placeholder{color:#4a3020;}
  .search-row input:focus{border-color:var(--fire2);}
  .refresh-btn{background:rgba(255,100,0,0.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 13px;color:var(--gold);font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;}
  .ocard{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:10px;animation:slideIn 0.3s ease;}
  .ocard-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:7px;}
  .ocard-ref{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold);-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold);}
  .ocard-badges{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .obadge{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.13);color:var(--fire2);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);}
  .obadge.pay{background:rgba(37,211,102,0.1);color:#25D366;border-color:rgba(37,211,102,0.25);}
  .ocard-info{font-size:12px;color:var(--cream);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px;}
  .ocard-addr{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:7px;}
  .ocard-items{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:9px;line-height:1.6;}
  .ocard-total{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:16px;color:var(--gold);-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:9px;}
  .status-row{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:7px;}
  .sbtn{flex:1;min-width:60px;padding:7px 3px;border:none;border-radius:9px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;opacity:0.38;white-space:nowrap;}
  .sbtn.active{opacity:1;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);}
  .sbtn-prep{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF8C00,#FFB800);color:#0d0300;}
  .sbtn-way{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25D366,#128C7E);color:white;}
  .sbtn-done{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:white;}
  .notify-btn{width:100%;margin-top:5px;background:var(--green);color:white;border:none;border-radius:9px;padding:8px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;display:block;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;}
  .notify-btn.drv{background:#128C7E;margin-top:3px;}
  .no-orders{text-align:center;padding:44px 0;color:var(--gray);}
  .no-orders span{font-size:38px;display:block;margin-bottom:11px;opacity:0.38;}
  .stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:11px;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .stat-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.16);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;text-align:center;}
  .stat-val{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:28px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
  .stat-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:3px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;}
  .top-items{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.16);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:11px;}
  .top-items-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px;}
  .top-item-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.06);font-size:11px;}
  .top-item-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .top-item-name{color:var(--cream);}
  .top-item-count{color:var(--fire2);font-weight:700;}
  .est-config{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.16);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:11px;}
  .est-config-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px;}
  .est-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:9px;}
  .est-row label{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);width:70px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .est-row input{flex:1;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 11px;background:rgba(255,100,0,0.05);color:var(--cream);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12px;outline:none;}
  .est-row input:focus{border-color:var(--fire2);}
  .menu-manager{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;}
  .mm-item{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.16);border-radius:11px;padding:11px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;}
  .mm-item.mm-sold{opacity:0.5;}
  .mm-info{flex:1;}
  .mm-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--cream);}
  .mm-price{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold);-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold);}
  .mm-toggle{background:rgba(255,100,0,0.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.22);border-radius:7px;padding:5px 10px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--gray);}
  .mm-toggle.sold{background:rgba(229,62,62,0.1);border-color:rgba(229,62,62,0.28);color:var(--red);}
  .deals-manage{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;}
  .dm-item{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.16);border-radius:11px;padding:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;}
  .dm-emoji{font-size:24px;}
  .dm-info{flex:1;}
  .dm-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--gold);}
  .dm-desc{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);}
  .dm-toggle{background:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.22);border-radius:20px;padding:5px 12px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--gray);}
  .dm-toggle.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));color:white;border-color:transparent;}

  .pin-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.92);z-index:400;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);}
  .pin-box{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1a0600,#0d0300);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.35);border-radius:24px;padding:36px 28px;max-width:320px;width:100%;text-align:center;position:relative;animation:slideIn 0.3s ease;}
  .pin-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--fire1),var(--gold),var(--fire2));border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;}
  .pin-lock{font-size:48px;margin-bottom:12px;display:block;}
  .pin-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--fire2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .pin-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:24px;}
  .pin-dots{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:24px;}
  .pin-dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.3);background:rgba(255,100,0,0.05);transition:all 0.2s;}
  .pin-dot.filled{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2));border-color:var(--fire2);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,69,0,0.4);}
  .pin-pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .pin-key{background:rgba(255,100,0,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.2);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:22px;color:var(--cream);cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.15s;letter-spacing:1px;}
  .pin-key:hover{background:rgba(255,100,0,0.18);border-color:var(--fire2);transform:scale(1.05);}
  .pin-key:active{transform:scale(0.95);}
  .pin-key.del{color:var(--fire2);font-size:16px;}
  .pin-key.zero{grid-column:2;}
  .pin-error{font-size:12px;color:var(--red);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;animation:slideIn 0.2s ease;}
  .pin-cancel{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);cursor:pointer;margin-top:8px;background:none;border:none;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;text-decoration:underline;}

  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--dark);}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--fire1);border-radius:3px;}
  @media(max-width:820px){.food-layout{flex-direction:column;}.cart-col{width:100%;}.cart-box{position:static;max-height:none;}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}.merch-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media(max-width:500px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.merch-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}.hdr{padding:0 13px;}.logo{font-size:20px;}.hero-title{font-size:34px;}.pay-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
`;



export default function App() {
  const [screen,     setScreen]     = useState("food");
  const [subScreen,  setSubScreen]  = useState(null);
  const [cart,       setCart]       = useState([]);
  const [modal,      setModal]      = useState(null);
  const [orderRef,   setOrderRef]   = useState("");
  const [zone,       setZone]       = useState(0);
  const [form,       setForm]       = useState({ name:"", phone:"", type:"dine-in", table:"", address:"", area:"", notes:"" });
  const [payMethod,  setPayMethod]  = useState("cash");
  const [curOrder,   setCurOrder]   = useState(null);
  const [soldOut,    setSoldOut]    = useState(new Set());
  const [estTime,    setEstTime]    = useState({ pickup:"15–20 mins", delivery:"35–45 mins" });
  const [selMerch,   setSelMerch]   = useState(null);
  const [selSize,    setSelSize]    = useState("");
  const [trackInput, setTrackInput] = useState("");
  const [trackRef,   setTrackRef]   = useState("");
  const [loading,    setLoading]    = useState(false);
  const [lastUpd,    setLastUpd]    = useState(null);
  const [orders,     setOrders]     = useState({});
  const [staffSearch,setStaffSearch]= useState("");
  const [staffTab,   setStaffTab]   = useState("orders");
  const [logoTaps,   setLogoTaps]   = useState(0);
  const [logoTimer,  setLogoTimer]  = useState(null);
  const [staffPin,   setStaffPin]   = useState("");
  const [pinError,   setPinError]   = useState(false);
  const [showPin,    setShowPin]    = useState(false);
  const [deals,      setDeals]      = useState(INITIAL_DEALS);
  const [loyalty,    setLoyalty]    = useState({ count:0, unlocked:false });
  const [reviews,    setReviews]    = useState([]);
  const [revForm,    setRevForm]    = useState({ name:"", stars:5, item:"", text:"" });
  const [myPhone,    setMyPhone]    = useState("");
  const [bday,       setBday]       = useState("");
  const [bdaySaved,  setBdaySaved]  = useState(false);
  const [refCode,    setRefCode]    = useState("");
  const [copied,     setCopied]     = useState(false);
  const [notifOk,    setNotifOk]    = useState(false);
  const [newDeals,   setNewDeals]   = useState(2);
  const prevStatusRef = useRef({});

  const isDel   = form.type === "delivery";
  const dfee    = isDel ? (zone===0 ? DELIVERY_NEAR : DELIVERY_FAR) : 0;
  const foodSub = cart.filter(i=>!i.isMerch).reduce((s,i)=>s+i.price*i.qty,0);
  const merchSub= cart.filter(i=>i.isMerch).reduce((s,i)=>s+i.price*i.qty,0);
  const sub     = foodSub + merchSub;
  const total   = sub + dfee;
  const qty     = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.qty,0);

  useEffect(()=>{
    loadOrders(); loadSoldOut(); loadEstTime();
    loadReviews(); loadMyProfile(); loadDeals();
    requestNotif();
    const stored=localStorage.getItem("tako-refcode");
    if(stored) setRefCode(stored);
    else { const c="TAKO-"+Math.random().toString(36).substring(2,6).toUpperCase(); localStorage.setItem("tako-refcode",c); setRefCode(c); }
  },[]);

  useEffect(()=>{
    if(subScreen==="track"&&trackRef){
      const iv=setInterval(async()=>{ await loadOrders(); setLastUpd(new Date().toLocaleTimeString()); },5000);
      return()=>clearInterval(iv);
    }
  },[subScreen,trackRef]);

  useEffect(()=>{
    if(!trackRef||!orders[trackRef]) return;
    const cur=orders[trackRef].status;
    const prev=prevStatusRef.current[trackRef];
    if(prev&&prev!==cur){ const s=STATUSES.find(x=>x.id===cur); if(s) sendNotif("TAKO! TAKO! Update 🌮",s.desc); }
    prevStatusRef.current={...prevStatusRef.current,[trackRef]:cur};
  },[orders,trackRef]);

  useEffect(()=>{
    if(form.phone.replace(/\s/g,"").length>=9) loadLoyaltyByPhone(form.phone);
    else setLoyalty({count:0,unlocked:false});
  },[form.phone]);

  const requestNotif=async()=>{ if("Notification" in window){ const p=await Notification.requestPermission(); setNotifOk(p==="granted"); }};
  const sendNotif=(t,b)=>{ if(notifOk&&"Notification" in window) new Notification(t,{body:b}); };
  const enc=s=>encodeURIComponent(s);
  const phoneWA=ph=>"27"+(ph||"").replace(/^0/,"").replace(/\s/g,"");

  const loadOrders=async()=>{ try{ const r=await window.storage.get("tako-orders-v5",true); if(r&&r.value) setOrders(JSON.parse(r.value)); }catch(e){} };
  const saveOrders=async(upd)=>{ try{ await window.storage.set("tako-orders-v5",JSON.stringify(upd),true); setOrders(upd); }catch(e){} };
  const loyKey=ph=>"tako-loy-"+ph.replace(/\s/g,"").replace(/^0/,"");
  const loadLoyaltyByPhone=async(ph)=>{ try{ const r=await window.storage.get(loyKey(ph),true); if(r&&r.value) setLoyalty(JSON.parse(r.value)); else setLoyalty({count:0,unlocked:false}); }catch(e){} };
  const saveLoyaltyByPhone=async(ph,data)=>{ try{ await window.storage.set(loyKey(ph),JSON.stringify(data),true); setLoyalty(data); }catch(e){} };
  const loadSoldOut=()=>{ try{ const r=localStorage.getItem("tako-soldout"); if(r) setSoldOut(new Set(JSON.parse(r))); }catch(e){} };
  const toggleSoldOut=id=>{ setSoldOut(prev=>{ const n=new Set(prev); n.has(id)?n.delete(id):n.add(id); localStorage.setItem("tako-soldout",JSON.stringify([...n])); return n; }); };
  const loadEstTime=()=>{ try{ const r=localStorage.getItem("tako-esttime"); if(r) setEstTime(JSON.parse(r)); }catch(e){} };
  const saveEstTime=upd=>{ localStorage.setItem("tako-esttime",JSON.stringify(upd)); setEstTime(upd); };
  const loadReviews=async()=>{ try{ const r=await window.storage.get("tako-reviews-v2",true); if(r&&r.value) setReviews(JSON.parse(r.value)); }catch(e){} };
  const saveReviews=async upd=>{ try{ await window.storage.set("tako-reviews-v2",JSON.stringify(upd),true); setReviews(upd); }catch(e){} };
  const loadMyProfile=()=>{ try{ const p=localStorage.getItem("tako-profile"); if(p){ const d=JSON.parse(p); setMyPhone(d.phone||""); setBday(d.bday||""); setBdaySaved(!!d.bday); }}catch(e){} };
  const saveMyProfile=()=>{ localStorage.setItem("tako-profile",JSON.stringify({phone:myPhone,bday})); setBdaySaved(true); if(myPhone.replace(/\s/g,"").length>=9) loadLoyaltyByPhone(myPhone); };
  const loadDeals=()=>{ try{ const d=localStorage.getItem("tako-deals-v2"); if(d) setDeals(JSON.parse(d)); }catch(e){} };
  const saveDeals=upd=>{ localStorage.setItem("tako-deals-v2",JSON.stringify(upd)); setDeals(upd); };

  const add=item=>{ if(soldOut.has(item.id)) return; setCart(p=>{ const f=p.find(c=>c.id===item.id&&!c.isMerch); if(f) return p.map(c=>c.id===item.id&&!c.isMerch?{...c,qty:c.qty+1}:c); return[...p,{...item,qty:1}]; }); };
  const adj=(id,d,isMerch=false)=>setCart(p=>p.map(c=>c.id===id&&(!!c.isMerch)===isMerch?{...c,qty:c.qty+d}:c).filter(c=>c.qty>0));
  const removeFree=()=>setCart(p=>p.filter(i=>!i.isFree));
  const addFreeReward=()=>{ if(loyalty.unlocked&&!cart.some(i=>i.isFree)) setCart(p=>[...p,{...FREE_REWARD,qty:1}]); };
  const addMerch=(item,size)=>{ const key=item.id+"_"+size; setCart(p=>{ const f=p.find(c=>c.id===key); if(f) return p.map(c=>c.id===key?{...c,qty:c.qty+1}:c); return[...p,{...item,id:key,name:item.name+(size!=="ONE SIZE"?" ("+size+")":""),qty:1,isMerch:true}]; }); setSelMerch(null); setSelSize(""); };

  const rMsg=(ref,o)=>enc("NEW TAKO! TAKO! ORDER\nRef: "+ref+"\nCustomer: "+o.name+"\nPhone: "+(o.phone||"N/A")+"\nType: "+(o.type==="delivery"?"DELIVERY: "+o.address+", "+o.area+" ("+o.zoneLabel+")":o.type==="dine-in"?"Dine In - Table "+(o.table||"—"):"Takeaway")+"\nItems: "+o.items+"\nSubtotal: R"+o.sub+(o.type==="delivery"?"\nDelivery: R"+o.dfee:"")+"\nTOTAL: R"+o.total+"\nPayment: "+o.payMethod+"\nNotes: "+(o.notes||"None"));
  const dMsg=(ref,o)=>enc("DELIVERY - TAKO! TAKO!\nRef: "+ref+"\nCustomer: "+o.name+"\nPhone: "+(o.phone||"N/A")+"\nCOLLECT: 143 Lunga Street, Ngema Section\nDELIVER TO: "+o.address+", "+o.area+" ("+o.zoneLabel+")\nItems: "+o.items+"\nCollect fee: R"+o.dfee+"\nPlease collect ASAP!");
  const onWayMsg=(ref,o)=>enc("Hi "+o.name+"!\n\nYour TAKO! TAKO! order is ON THE WAY!\nRef: "+ref+"\nDriver heading to: "+o.address+", "+o.area+"\nETA: "+estTime.delivery+"\n\nIDLA SOFT DAWG! 🌮");
  const readyMsg=(ref,o)=>enc("Hi "+o.name+"!\n\nYour TAKO! TAKO! order "+ref+" is READY!\nCollect from: 143 Lunga Street, Ngema Section\nEst: "+estTime.pickup+"\nIDLA SOFT DAWG! 🌮");

  const confirm=async()=>{
    if(!form.name) return;
    if(isDel&&(!form.address||!form.area)) return;
    const ref="TK-"+Math.random().toString(36).substring(2,6).toUpperCase();
    const cartItems=cart.map(i=>i.qty+"x "+i.name+(i.isFree?" (FREE)":"")).join(", ");
    const o={ ...form, cartArr:cart.map(i=>({...i})), items:cartItems, sub:foodSub, dfee, total, zoneLabel:isDel?(zone===0?"Within 5km":"6–10km+"):null, status:"received", time:Date.now(), payMethod, estTime:isDel?estTime.delivery:estTime.pickup, hasFreeItem:cart.some(i=>i.isFree) };
    await saveOrders({...orders,[ref]:o});
    setOrderRef(ref); setCurOrder(o);
    setTimeout(()=>window.open("https://wa.me/"+RESTO_WA+"?text="+rMsg(ref,o),"_blank"),800);
    if(isDel) setTimeout(()=>window.open("https://wa.me/"+DRIVER_WA+"?text="+dMsg(ref,o),"_blank"),1600);
    const isRed=cart.some(i=>i.isFree);
    if(isRed){ await saveLoyaltyByPhone(form.phone,{count:0,unlocked:false}); }
    else if(foodSub>=LOYALTY_MIN_SUB){ const nc=Math.min(loyalty.count+1,LOYALTY_GOAL); await saveLoyaltyByPhone(form.phone,{count:nc,unlocked:nc>=LOYALTY_GOAL}); }
    setModal("success");
  };

  const updateStatus=async(ref,ns)=>{ const upd={...orders,[ref]:{...orders[ref],status:ns}}; await saveOrders(upd); };
  const reset=()=>{ setModal(null);setCart([]);setForm({name:"",phone:"",type:"dine-in",table:"",address:"",area:"",notes:""});setOrderRef("");setZone(0);setCurOrder(null);setPayMethod("cash");setLoyalty({count:0,unlocked:false}); };
  const handleLogoTap=()=>{ const t=logoTaps+1; setLogoTaps(t); if(logoTimer) clearTimeout(logoTimer); if(t>=5){setLogoTaps(0);setShowPin(true);return;} setLogoTimer(setTimeout(()=>setLogoTaps(0),2000)); };
  const checkPin=()=>{ if(staffPin==="2580"){setShowPin(false);setStaffPin("");setPinError(false);setSubScreen("staff");} else{setPinError(true);setStaffPin("");setTimeout(()=>setPinError(false),2000);} };

  const submitReview=async()=>{
    if(!revForm.name||!revForm.text) return;
    const upd=[{...revForm,date:new Date().toLocaleDateString(),time:Date.now()},...reviews];
    await saveReviews(upd);
    setRevForm({name:"",stars:5,item:"",text:""});
  };

  const ok=form.name&&(!isDel||(form.address&&form.area));
  const trackedOrder=orders[trackRef];
  const sIdx=trackedOrder?STATUSES.findIndex(s=>s.id===trackedOrder.status):-1;
  const allOrders=Object.entries(orders).sort((a,b)=>b[1].time-a[1].time);
  const filtered=staffSearch?allOrders.filter(([r,o])=>r.includes(staffSearch.toUpperCase())||o.name.toLowerCase().includes(staffSearch.toLowerCase())):allOrders;
  const today=new Date().toDateString();
  const todayOrders=allOrders.filter(([r,o])=>new Date(o.time).toDateString()===today);
  const todayRev=todayOrders.reduce((s,[r,o])=>s+o.total,0);
  const todayDel=todayOrders.filter(([r,o])=>o.type==="delivery").length;
  const itemCounts={};
  todayOrders.forEach(([r,o])=>{(o.cartArr||[]).forEach(i=>{itemCounts[i.name]=(itemCounts[i.name]||0)+i.qty;});});
  const topItems=Object.entries(itemCounts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,5);
  const allFoodItems=FOOD_MENU.flatMap(c=>c.items);
  const myOrders=Object.entries(orders).filter(([r,o])=>o.phone&&myPhone&&o.phone.replace(/\s/g,"")===myPhone.replace(/\s/g,"")).sort((a,b)=>b[1].time-a[1].time).slice(0,5);
  const isBdayMonth=bdaySaved&&bday&&new Date().getMonth()===new Date(bday).getMonth();

  const navItems=[
    {id:"food",      icon:"🌮", label:"Food"},
    {id:"merch",     icon:"👕", label:"Merch"},
    {id:"deals",     icon:"⚡", label:"Deals", notif:newDeals},
    {id:"community", icon:"💬", label:"Vibes"},
    {id:"me",        icon:"👤", label:"My TAKO!"},
  ];

  const PayInfo=()=>{
    if(payMethod==="cash") return <div className="pay-confirm-box"><div className="pct">CASH PAYMENT</div><div className="pcd">{isDel?"Pay the driver when your order arrives.":"Pay at the counter when you collect."}</div></div>;
    if(payMethod==="card") return <div className="pay-confirm-box"><div className="pct">CARD PAYMENT</div><div className="pcd">{isDel?"Driver has a card machine on arrival.":"Tap or swipe at the counter."}</div></div>;
    return <div className="pay-confirm-box"><div className="pct">EFT PAYMENT</div><div className="pcd" style={{lineHeight:"2"}}><strong>Bank: {BANK_NAME}</strong><strong>Account: {BANK_ACCOUNT}</strong><strong>Branch: {BANK_BRANCH}</strong><strong>Name: {BANK_HOLDER}</strong>Ref: <strong style={{color:"var(--gold)"}}>{orderRef}</strong></div></div>;
  };

  const OrderModal=()=>(
    <div className="overlay"><div className="modal">
      <div className="m-title">YOUR DETAILS 🔥</div>
      <div className="m-sub">How would you like your TAKO! TAKO!?</div>
      <div className="type-sel">{[{v:"dine-in",l:"🍽️ Dine In"},{v:"takeaway",l:"🥡 Takeaway"},{v:"delivery",l:"🛵 Delivery"}].map(t=><button key={t.v} className={"tbtn"+(form.type===t.v?" on":"")} onClick={()=>setForm({...form,type:t.v})}>{t.l}</button>)}</div>
      {isDel&&<><div className="zone-sel">{[{l:"Within 5km",f:DELIVERY_NEAR},{l:"6km–10km+",f:DELIVERY_FAR}].map((z,i)=><button key={i} className={"zbtn"+(zone===i?" on":"")} onClick={()=>setZone(i)}>{z.l}<br/><strong>R{z.f}</strong></button>)}</div><div className="dnote">🛵 Delivery fee: R{dfee} · {estTime.delivery}</div></>}
      <div className="fg"><label>Your Name *</label><input placeholder="e.g. Sipho" value={form.name} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,name:e.target.value})}/></div>
      <div className="fg"><label>Phone {isDel?"*":"(optional — loyalty & updates)"}</label><input placeholder="071 234 5678" value={form.phone} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,phone:e.target.value})}/></div>
      {form.phone.replace(/\s/g,"").length>=9&&<div style={{fontSize:"10px",color:"var(--gold)",marginTop:"-7px",marginBottom:"9px"}}>🔥 Loyalty: {loyalty.unlocked?"FREE REWARD READY!":loyalty.count+"/"+LOYALTY_GOAL+" qualifying orders"}</div>}
      {form.type==="dine-in"&&<div className="fg"><label>Table Number</label><input placeholder="e.g. Table 3" value={form.table} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,table:e.target.value})}/></div>}
      {isDel&&<><div className="fg"><label>Street Address *</label><input placeholder="45 Mthembu Street" value={form.address} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,address:e.target.value})}/></div><div className="fg"><label>Area / Suburb *</label><input placeholder="e.g. Ngema Section" value={form.area} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,area:e.target.value})}/></div></>}
      <div className="fg"><label>Notes (optional)</label><input placeholder="Extra hot sauce, allergies..." value={form.notes} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,notes:e.target.value})}/></div>
      <div className="sec-title">Payment Method</div>
      <div className="pay-grid">{[{v:"cash",pi:"💵",pn:"Cash",ps:isDel?"Pay driver":"At counter"},{v:"card",pi:"💳",pn:"Card",ps:isDel?"On delivery":"Tap counter"},{v:"eft",pi:"📱",pn:"EFT",ps:"Bank transfer"}].map(p=><div key={p.v} className={"pay-card"+(payMethod===p.v?" on":"")} onClick={()=>setPayMethod(p.v)}><div className="pi">{p.pi}</div><div className="pn">{p.pn}</div><div className="ps">{p.ps}</div></div>)}</div>
      {payMethod==="eft"&&<div className="eft-details"><strong>Bank: {BANK_NAME}</strong><strong>Account: {BANK_ACCOUNT}</strong><strong>Branch: {BANK_BRANCH}</strong><strong>Name: {BANK_HOLDER}</strong>Use order ref as payment reference.</div>}
      <div className="m-actions"><button className="bbtn" onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>← Back</button><button className="cbtn" disabled={!ok} onClick={confirm}>CONFIRM · R{total}</button></div>
    </div></div>
  );

  const SuccessModal=()=>{
    const isRed=curOrder?.hasFreeItem;
    const qual=curOrder&&curOrder.sub>=LOYALTY_MIN_SUB&&!isRed;
    return(
    <div className="overlay"><div className="modal"><div className="sbox">
      <div className="sicon">{isDel?"🛵":"🔥"}</div>
      <div className="stitle">ORDER PLACED!</div>
      <div className="ssub">{isDel?"Preparing your TAKO! Driver will deliver to "+form.address+"!":"Your TAKO! TAKO! is confirmed — fresh food incoming!"}</div>
      <div className="sref">{orderRef}</div>
      <div className="est-box"><div className="ei">⏱️</div><div><div className="et">{curOrder?.estTime}</div><div className="es">Estimated {isDel?"delivery":"pickup"} time</div></div></div>
      <PayInfo/>
      <div style={{fontSize:"10px",color:"var(--gray)",margin:"9px 0",textAlign:"left"}}>📲 Restaurant {isDel?"& driver have been":"has been"} auto-notified via WhatsApp.</div>
      <button className="obtn" style={{marginBottom:"9px",fontSize:"15px",letterSpacing:"2px"}} onClick={()=>{setModal(null);setTrackRef(orderRef);setSubScreen("track");}}>📦 TRACK MY ORDER LIVE</button>
      {isRed&&<div className="loy-unlock-card" style={{borderColor:"rgba(37,211,102,0.35)",background:"linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(37,211,102,0.09),rgba(18,140,126,0.05))"}}><span className="lui">🔄</span><div className="lut" style={{color:"#25D366"}}>REWARD REDEEMED!</div><div className="lus">Cycle reset — keep ordering for your next free combo!</div></div>}
      {!isRed&&qual&&loyalty.count>=LOYALTY_GOAL&&<div className="loy-unlock-card"><span className="lui">🏆</span><div className="lut">REWARD UNLOCKED!</div><div className="lus">7 orders done! FREE Buffalo Wings & Ribs on your next order!</div></div>}
      {!isRed&&qual&&loyalty.count<LOYALTY_GOAL&&<div className="loy-prog-card"><div className="loy-prog-hd">LOYALTY PROGRESS <span>{loyalty.count}/{LOYALTY_GOAL}</span></div><div className="loy-dots">{Array.from({length:LOYALTY_GOAL}).map((_,i)=><div key={i} className={"loy-dot"+(i<loyalty.count?" done":"")}>{i<loyalty.count?"🔥":""}</div>)}</div><div className="loy-prog-msg">{LOYALTY_GOAL-loyalty.count} more order{LOYALTY_GOAL-loyalty.count!==1?"s":""} (R50+) to earn FREE combo!</div></div>}
      <button className="nbtn" onClick={()=>{reset();setSubScreen(null);}} style={{marginTop:"11px"}}>NEW ORDER</button>
      <span className="slogan">IDLA SOFT · PHILA SOFT</span>
    </div></div></div>
  );};

  const TrackerScreen=()=>(
    <div className="tracker-wrap">
      {!trackedOrder?(
        <div style={{textAlign:"center",paddingTop:"36px"}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:"44px",marginBottom:"14px"}}>🔍</div>
          <div style={{fontFamily:"'Bebas Neue',sans-serif",fontSize:"20px",color:"var(--gray)",letterSpacing:"2px",marginBottom:"7px"}}>ORDER NOT FOUND</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:"12px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"22px"}}><strong style={{color:"var(--gold)"}}>{trackRef}</strong> doesn't exist. Double-check your code.</div>
          <button className="obtn" onClick={()=>{setSubScreen("track-input");setTrackInput("");setTrackRef("");}}>TRY AGAIN</button>
        </div>
      ):<>
        <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginBottom:"22px"}}>
          <div className="live-badge"><span className="live-dot"/> LIVE · UPDATES EVERY 5s</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:"10px",letterSpacing:"3px",color:"var(--gray)",textTransform:"uppercase",marginBottom:"5px"}}>Your Order</div>
          <span className="tracker-code">{trackRef}</span>
          <div className="tracker-meta" style={{marginTop:"5px"}}>
            Hey <strong>{trackedOrder.name}</strong>! 👋
            {trackedOrder.type==="delivery"&&<div style={{marginTop:"3px"}}>🛵 Delivering to {trackedOrder.address}, {trackedOrder.area}</div>}
            {trackedOrder.type==="dine-in"&&<div style={{marginTop:"3px"}}>🍽️ Dine In · Table {trackedOrder.table||"—"}</div>}
            {trackedOrder.type==="takeaway"&&<div style={{marginTop:"3px"}}>🥡 Takeaway · Collect at counter</div>}
            {trackedOrder.estTime&&<div style={{marginTop:"3px",color:"var(--fire2)",fontWeight:"600"}}>⏱️ Est. {trackedOrder.estTime}</div>}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="status-steps">
          {STATUSES.map((s,i)=>{ const done=i<sIdx,active=i===sIdx,last=i===STATUSES.length-1; return(
            <div key={s.id} className="status-step">
              <div className="step-left">
                <div className={"step-icon"+(done?" done":active?" active":"")}>{done?"✅":s.icon}</div>
                {!last&&<div className={"step-line"+(done?" done":"")}/>}
              </div>
              <div className="step-right">
                <div className={"step-label"+(done?" done":active?" active":"")}>{s.label}</div>
                <div className={"step-desc"+(active?" active":"")}>{active?s.desc:done?"Completed ✓":"Upcoming"}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );})}
        </div>
        {trackedOrder.status==="ontheway"&&trackedOrder.type==="delivery"&&<div className="alert-card onway"><span className="alert-icon">🛵</span><div className="alert-title">DRIVER IS ON THE WAY!</div><div className="alert-sub">Heading to {trackedOrder.address}. Get ready!</div></div>}
        {trackedOrder.status==="preparing"&&trackedOrder.type!=="delivery"&&<div className="alert-card ready"><span className="alert-icon">👨‍🍳</span><div className="alert-title">ALMOST READY!</div><div className="alert-sub">Your TAKO! TAKO! is being freshly made. Head over!</div></div>}
        {trackedOrder.status==="delivered"&&<div className="alert-card done"><span className="alert-icon">🎉</span><div className="alert-title">ENJOY YOUR TAKO!</div><div className="alert-sub">IDLA SOFT DAWG! Come back soon 🌮</div></div>}
        {lastUpd&&<div className="last-updated">LAST UPDATED {lastUpd}</div>}
        <div style={{marginTop:"22px",display:"flex",gap:"9px",flexDirection:"column"}}>
          <button className="obtn" onClick={()=>{setSubScreen("track-input");setTrackInput("");setTrackRef("");}}>TRACK ANOTHER ORDER</button>
          <button className="bbtn" style={{padding:"11px"}} onClick={()=>setSubScreen(null)}>← Back</button>
        </div>
      </>}
    </div>
  );

  const StaffScreen=()=>(
    <div className="staff-wrap">
      <div className="staff-title">STAFF MODE 🔐</div>
      <div className="staff-sub">Tap logo 5× to access · Real-time across all devices</div>
      <div className="staff-tabs">
        {[["orders","📋 Orders"],["menu","🍽️ Menu"],["deals","⚡ Deals"],["stats","📊 Stats"]].map(([v,l])=>(
          <button key={v} className={"staff-tab"+(staffTab===v?" on":"")} onClick={()=>setStaffTab(v)}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {staffTab==="orders"&&<>
        <div className="search-row"><input placeholder="Search by ref or name..." value={staffSearch} onChange={e=>setStaffSearch(e.target.value)}/><button className="refresh-btn" onClick={loadOrders}>↻</button></div>
        {filtered.length===0?<div className="no-orders"><span>📋</span>No orders yet.</div>:filtered.map(([ref,o])=>{
          const si=STATUSES.findIndex(s=>s.id===o.status); return(
          <div key={ref} className="ocard">
            <div className="ocard-top"><span className="ocard-ref">{ref}</span><div className="ocard-badges"><span className="obadge">{o.type==="delivery"?"🛵 DEL":o.type==="takeaway"?"🥡 T/A":"🍽️ DINE"}</span><span className="obadge pay">💳 {o.payMethod||"cash"}</span><span className="obadge">{STATUSES[si]?.icon} {STATUSES[si]?.label}</span></div></div>
            <div className="ocard-info">👤 {o.name} {o.phone&&"· 📞 "+o.phone}</div>
            {o.type==="delivery"&&<div className="ocard-addr">📍 {o.address}, {o.area} ({o.zoneLabel})</div>}
            {o.type==="dine-in"&&<div className="ocard-addr">🪑 Table {o.table||"—"}</div>}
            <div className="ocard-items">{o.items}</div>
            {o.notes&&<div className="ocard-addr" style={{color:"var(--fire2)"}}>📝 {o.notes}</div>}
            <div className="ocard-total">TOTAL: R{o.total}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:"9px",color:"var(--gray)",textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"1px",marginBottom:"7px"}}>Update Status:</div>
            <div className="status-row">
              <button className={"sbtn sbtn-prep"+(o.status==="preparing"?" active":"")} onClick={()=>updateStatus(ref,"preparing")}>👨‍🍳 Preparing</button>
              <button className={"sbtn sbtn-way"+(o.status==="ontheway"?" active":"")} onClick={()=>updateStatus(ref,"ontheway")}>🛵 On Way</button>
              <button className={"sbtn sbtn-done"+(o.status==="delivered"?" active":"")} onClick={()=>updateStatus(ref,"delivered")}>✅ Done</button>
            </div>
            {o.status==="ontheway"&&o.type==="delivery"&&o.phone&&<a href={"https://wa.me/"+phoneWA(o.phone)+"?text="+onWayMsg(ref,o)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="notify-btn">📲 WhatsApp — On The Way!</a>}
            {o.status==="preparing"&&o.type!=="delivery"&&o.phone&&<a href={"https://wa.me/"+phoneWA(o.phone)+"?text="+readyMsg(ref,o)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="notify-btn">📲 WhatsApp — Order Ready!</a>}
            {o.type==="delivery"&&<a href={"https://wa.me/"+DRIVER_WA+"?text="+dMsg(ref,o)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="notify-btn drv">🛵 Re-notify Driver</a>}
          </div>);
        })}
      </>}

      {staffTab==="menu"&&<>
        <div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"12px"}}>Toggle items sold out — updates instantly for customers.</div>
        <div className="menu-manager">
          {allFoodItems.map(item=>{ const so=soldOut.has(item.id); return(
            <div key={item.id} className={"mm-item"+(so?" mm-sold":"")}>
              <div style={{fontSize:"22px"}}>🌮</div>
              <div className="mm-info"><div className="mm-name">{item.name}</div><div className="mm-price">R{item.price}</div></div>
              <button className={"mm-toggle"+(so?" sold":"")} onClick={()=>toggleSoldOut(item.id)}>{so?"SOLD OUT ✕":"AVAILABLE ✓"}</button>
            </div>);})}
        </div>
      </>}

      {staffTab==="deals"&&<>
        <div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"12px"}}>Toggle deals on/off — customers see live changes instantly.</div>
        <div className="deals-manage">
          {deals.map((d,i)=>(
            <div key={d.id} className="dm-item">
              <div className="dm-emoji">{d.emoji}</div>
              <div className="dm-info"><div className="dm-title">{d.title}</div><div className="dm-desc">{d.desc} · {d.expires}</div></div>
              <button className={"dm-toggle"+(d.active?" on":"")} onClick={()=>{ const upd=deals.map((x,j)=>j===i?{...x,active:!x.active}:x); saveDeals(upd); }}>{d.active?"LIVE":"OFF"}</button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </>}

      {staffTab==="stats"&&<>
        <div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"12px",textAlign:"center"}}>{new Date().toDateString()}</div>
        <div className="stats-grid">
          <div className="stat-card"><div className="stat-val">{todayOrders.length}</div><div className="stat-label">Orders Today</div></div>
          <div className="stat-card"><div className="stat-val">R{todayRev}</div><div className="stat-label">Revenue Today</div></div>
          <div className="stat-card"><div className="stat-val">{todayDel}</div><div className="stat-label">Deliveries</div></div>
          <div className="stat-card"><div className="stat-val">R{todayOrders.length?Math.round(todayRev/todayOrders.length):0}</div><div className="stat-label">Avg Order</div></div>
        </div>
        {topItems.length>0&&<div className="top-items"><div className="top-items-title">TOP SELLERS TODAY</div>{topItems.map(([name,count])=><div key={name} className="top-item-row"><span className="top-item-name">{name}</span><span className="top-item-count">{count}x</span></div>)}</div>}
        <div className="est-config">
          <div className="est-config-title">WAIT TIME SETTINGS</div>
          <div className="est-row"><label>Pickup</label><input value={estTime.pickup} onChange={e=>saveEstTime({...estTime,pickup:e.target.value})} placeholder="15–20 mins"/></div>
          <div className="est-row"><label>Delivery</label><input value={estTime.delivery} onChange={e=>saveEstTime({...estTime,delivery:e.target.value})} placeholder="35–45 mins"/></div>
        </div>
      </>}
    </div>
  );

  const Header=()=>(
    <header className="hdr">
      <div className="logo-wrap" onClick={handleLogoTap}>
        <div className="logo">TAKO! TAKO!</div>
        <div className="logo-sub">Idla Soft · Phila Soft</div>
      </div>
      <div className="hdr-right">
        {subScreen&&<button className="ghost-pill" onClick={()=>setSubScreen(null)}>← Back</button>}
        {!subScreen&&<button className="ghost-pill" onClick={()=>setSubScreen("track-input")}>📦 Track</button>}
        {!subScreen&&<button className="cart-pill" onClick={()=>qty>0&&setModal("order")}>🛒 {qty>0&&<span className="cbadge">{qty}</span>}</button>}
      </div>
    </header>
  );

  if(subScreen==="track-input") return (
    <><style>{CSS}</style><div className="app"><div className="fire-bg"/><Header/>
      <div className="track-input-page">
        <div style={{fontSize:"48px",marginBottom:"14px"}}>📦</div>
        <div style={{fontFamily:"'Bebas Neue',sans-serif",fontSize:"26px",letterSpacing:"3px",background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#FFD700,#FF8C00)",WebkitBackgroundClip:"text",WebkitTextFillColor:"transparent",marginBottom:"8px"}}>TRACK YOUR ORDER</div>
        <div style={{fontSize:"12px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"24px"}}>Enter your order reference for live status</div>
        <div className="fg" style={{textAlign:"left"}}><label>Order Reference</label>
          <input placeholder="e.g. TK-AB12" value={trackInput} onChange={e=>setTrackInput(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} style={{textAlign:"center",fontSize:"18px",letterSpacing:"4px",fontFamily:"'Bebas Neue',sans-serif"}} onKeyDown={e=>{if(e.key==="Enter"&&trackInput.trim()){setTrackRef(trackInput.trim());setSubScreen("track");}}}/>
        </div>
        <button className="obtn" style={{marginTop:"8px"}} disabled={!trackInput.trim()||loading} onClick={async()=>{setLoading(true);await loadOrders();setLoading(false);setTrackRef(trackInput.trim());setSubScreen("track");}}>
          {loading?"SEARCHING...":"TRACK NOW →"}
        </button>
      </div>
      {modal==="order"&&<OrderModal/>}{modal==="success"&&curOrder&&<SuccessModal/>}
    </div></>
  );

  if(subScreen==="track") return (
    <><style>{CSS}</style><div className="app"><div className="fire-bg"/><Header/><TrackerScreen/>
      {modal==="order"&&<OrderModal/>}{modal==="success"&&curOrder&&<SuccessModal/>}
    </div></>
  );

  if(subScreen==="staff") return (
    <><style>{CSS}</style><div className="app"><div className="fire-bg"/><Header/><StaffScreen/>
    </div></>
  );

  return (
    <><style>{CSS}</style>
    <div className="app">
      <div className="fire-bg"/>
      <Header/>

      {screen==="food"&&<>
        <div className="hero">
          <div className="hero-left">
            <div className="hero-title">IDLA SOFT<br/>DAWG.</div>
            <div className="hero-addr">📍 143 Lunga Street, Ngema Section</div>
            <div className="hours-pill">⏰ Mon–Sat · 10AM–9PM</div>
          </div>
          <div className="hero-flames">🌮🔥🌶️</div>
        </div>
        <div className="info-bar">
          <div className="info-item">📞 <a href="https://wa.me/27694422688">069 442 2688</a></div>
          <div className="info-item">📍 Ngema Section</div>
        </div>
        <div className="dbanner"><div className="dbicon">🛵</div><div><p>We Deliver To Your Door!</p><small>R35 within 5km · R45 for 6–10km+ · Choose at checkout</small></div></div>
        {loyalty.unlocked&&!cart.some(i=>i.isFree)&&<div className="loy-banner win"><div className="loy-icon">🏆</div><div className="loy-content"><div className="loy-title">FREE REWARD UNLOCKED!</div><div style={{fontSize:"10px",color:"var(--gray)",marginTop:"2px"}}>You earned a FREE Buffalo Wings & Ribs! Add to your order.</div></div><button className="loy-claim-btn" onClick={addFreeReward}>ADD FREE</button></div>}
        {!loyalty.unlocked&&loyalty.count>0&&<div className="loy-banner prog"><div className="loy-icon">🔥</div><div className="loy-content"><div className="loy-title">LOYALTY — {loyalty.count}/{LOYALTY_GOAL}</div><div className="loy-bar-wrap"><div className="loy-bar-fill" style={{width:(loyalty.count/LOYALTY_GOAL*100)+"%"}}/></div><div className="loy-count">{LOYALTY_GOAL-loyalty.count} more qualifying order{LOYALTY_GOAL-loyalty.count!==1?"s":""} (R50+) for FREE combo</div></div></div>}
        <div className="food-layout">
          <div className="menu-col">
            {FOOD_MENU.map(cat=>(
              <div key={cat.category}>
                <div className="sec-div"><div className="sec-icon">{cat.icon}</div><div className="sec-label">{cat.category}</div><div className="sec-icon">{cat.icon}</div></div>
                <div className="grid">
                  {cat.items.map(item=>{ const so=soldOut.has(item.id); return(
                    <div key={item.id} className={"card"+(so?" soldout":"")} onClick={()=>!so&&add(item)}>
                      <div className="card-img-wrap">{item.img?<img src={item.img} alt={item.name} className="card-img"/>:<div className="no-img">🌮</div>}{so?<div className="soldout-tag">SOLD OUT</div>:item.tag&&<div className="ctag">{item.tag}</div>}</div>
                      <div className="card-body"><div className="cname">{item.name}</div><div className="cdesc">{item.desc}</div><div className="cfooter"><span className="cprice">R{item.price}</span><button className="addbtn" disabled={so} onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();!so&&add(item);}}>+</button></div></div>
                    </div>);})}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="cart-col"><div className="cart-box">
            <div className="cart-hd">YOUR ORDER {qty>0&&<span className="cqbadge">{qty} item{qty!==1?"s":""}</span>}</div>
            {cart.length===0?<div className="empty"><span className="eicon">🌮</span>Tap any item to start your order</div>:<>
              {cart.map(item=>(
                <div key={item.id+"_"+(item.isMerch?"m":"f")} className="ci">
                  <div className="ci-name">{item.name}{item.isFree&&<span className="ci-badge free">FREE</span>}{item.isMerch&&<span className="ci-badge merch">MERCH</span>}</div>
                  <div className="qty">{item.isFree?<button className="qb" style={{background:"rgba(229,62,62,0.13)"}} onClick={removeFree}>✕</button>:<><button className="qb" onClick={()=>adj(item.id,-1,!!item.isMerch)}>−</button><span className="qn">{item.qty}</span><button className="qb" onClick={()=>adj(item.id,1,!!item.isMerch)}>+</button></>}</div>
                  <div className="ci-price">{item.isFree?"FREE":"R"+(item.price*item.qty)}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
              <hr className="cdiv"/>
              <div className="crow"><span>Subtotal</span><span>R{sub}</span></div>
              {isDel&&<div className="crow dr"><span>🛵 Delivery</span><span>R{dfee}</span></div>}
              <div className="ctotal"><span className="ctlabel">TOTAL</span><span className="ctval">R{total}</span></div>
              <button className="obtn" onClick={()=>setModal("order")}>PLACE ORDER 🔥</button>
            </>}
