          </div></div>
        </div>
      </>}

      {screen==="merch"&&<>
        <div className="page-hero"><div className="page-hero-content"><div className="page-title">TAKO! STORE 👕</div><div className="page-sub">PHILA SOFT DAWG · No Shortcuts Just Flavor · Details Matter</div></div></div>
        <div className="page-wrap">
          {MERCH_CATALOG.map(cat=>(
            <div key={cat.category}>
              <div className="sec-div"><div className="sec-icon">{cat.icon}</div><div className="sec-label">{cat.category}</div><div className="sec-icon">{cat.icon}</div></div>
              <div className="merch-grid">
                {cat.items.map(item=>{
                  const bg=item.color.toLowerCase().includes("cream")||item.color.toLowerCase().includes("bone")||item.color.toLowerCase().includes("white")?"light":item.color.toLowerCase().includes("orange")?"orange":"dark";
                  return(<div key={item.id} className="m-card" onClick={()=>{setSelMerch(item);setSelSize(item.sizes[0]);}}>
                    <div className={"m-card-vis "+bg}><div className="m-emoji">{item.emoji}</div>{item.tag&&<div className="m-card-tag">{item.tag}</div>}</div>
                    <div className="m-card-body"><div className="m-card-name">{item.name}</div><div className="m-card-color">{item.color}</div><div className="m-card-footer"><span className="m-card-price">R{item.price}</span><button className="m-add-btn" onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();setSelMerch(item);setSelSize(item.sizes[0]);}}>+</button></div></div>
                  </div>);})}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </>}

      {screen==="deals"&&<>
        <div className="page-hero"><div className="page-hero-content"><div className="page-title">DEALS ⚡</div><div className="page-sub">Flash drops · Limited time · IDLA SOFT DAWG</div></div></div>
        <div className="page-wrap" style={{paddingTop:"20px"}}>
          <div className="deals-grid">
            {deals.filter(d=>d.active).length===0&&<div className="no-orders"><span>⚡</span>No active deals right now. Check back soon!</div>}
            {deals.filter(d=>d.active).map(d=>(
              <div key={d.id} className="deal-card">
                <div className="deal-emoji">{d.emoji}</div>
                <div className="deal-info"><div className="deal-title">{d.title}</div><div className="deal-desc">{d.desc}</div><div className="deal-expires">⏰ {d.expires}</div></div>
                <div className="deal-price-wrap">{d.original>0&&<div className="deal-original">R{d.original}</div>}{d.deal===0?<div className="deal-free">FREE</div>:<div className="deal-deal">R{d.deal}</div>}{d.original>0&&d.deal>0&&<div className="deal-save">SAVE R{d.original-d.deal}</div>}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div style={{marginTop:"24px",background:"linear-gradient(145deg,var(--dark3),#1f0900)",border:"1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.15)",borderRadius:"16px",padding:"18px",textAlign:"center"}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:"28px",marginBottom:"8px"}}>🔔</div>
            <div style={{fontFamily:"'Bebas Neue',sans-serif",fontSize:"16px",letterSpacing:"2px",color:"var(--gold)",marginBottom:"6px"}}>NEVER MISS A DEAL</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"12px"}}>Add TAKO! TAKO! to your home screen and allow notifications for flash deals.</div>
            <button className="obtn" style={{fontSize:"14px",letterSpacing:"2px"}} onClick={()=>setScreen("food")}>ORDER NOW 🔥</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </>}

      {screen==="community"&&<>
        <div className="page-hero"><div className="page-hero-content"><div className="page-title">COMMUNITY 💬</div><div className="page-sub">Real talk from the TAKO! TAKO! family · Rate your experience</div></div></div>
        <div className="page-wrap" style={{paddingTop:"20px"}}>
          <div className="review-form">
            <div className="review-form-title">LEAVE A REVIEW</div>
            <div className="fg"><label>Your Name</label><input placeholder="e.g. Sipho M." value={revForm.name} onChange={e=>setRevForm({...revForm,name:e.target.value})}/></div>
            <div className="fg"><label>What did you order?</label><input placeholder="e.g. Ultimate Fully Loaded" value={revForm.item} onChange={e=>setRevForm({...revForm,item:e.target.value})}/></div>
            <div style={{marginBottom:"12px"}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:"9px",fontWeight:"700",textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"2px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"6px"}}>Rating</div>
              <div className="star-row">{[1,2,3,4,5].map(s=><button key={s} className="star-btn" onClick={()=>setRevForm({...revForm,stars:s})}>{s<=revForm.stars?"⭐":"☆"}</button>)}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="fg"><label>Your Review</label><textarea rows={3} placeholder="Tell the TAKO! family how it was..." value={revForm.text} onChange={e=>setRevForm({...revForm,text:e.target.value})}/></div>
            <button className="obtn" style={{fontSize:"15px",letterSpacing:"2px"}} disabled={!revForm.name||!revForm.text} onClick={submitReview}>POST REVIEW 🔥</button>
          </div>
          {reviews.length===0?<div className="no-orders"><span>💬</span>No reviews yet. Be the first!</div>:(
            <div className="review-grid">
              {reviews.map((r,i)=>(
                <div key={i} className="review-card">
                  <div className="review-top"><div className="review-name">{r.name}</div><div className="review-stars">{"⭐".repeat(r.stars)}</div></div>
                  {r.item&&<div className="review-item">{r.item}</div>}
                  <div className="review-text">{r.text}</div>
                  <div className="review-date">{r.date}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </>}

      {screen==="me"&&<>
        <div className="page-hero"><div className="page-hero-content"><div className="page-title">MY TAKO! 👤</div><div className="page-sub">Loyalty, rewards, referrals & order history</div></div></div>
        <div className="page-wrap" style={{paddingTop:"20px"}}>
          <div className="profile-card">
            <div className="profile-title">MY PROFILE</div>
            <div className="fg"><label>My Phone Number</label><input placeholder="071 234 5678 — links your loyalty" value={myPhone} onChange={e=>setMyPhone(e.target.value)}/></div>
            <div style={{marginBottom:"12px"}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:"9px",fontWeight:"700",textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"2px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"6px"}}>Birthday — unlock birthday reward</div>
              <div className="bday-row"><input type="date" value={bday} onChange={e=>setBday(e.target.value)}/><button className="save-btn" onClick={saveMyProfile}>SAVE</button></div>
              {bdaySaved&&isBdayMonth&&<div className="bday-reward">🎂 Happy Birthday! Show this to get a FREE Extra Cheese on your next visit!</div>}
              {bdaySaved&&!isBdayMonth&&<div style={{fontSize:"10px",color:"var(--gray)",marginTop:"8px"}}>🎂 Birthday reward activates in your birthday month!</div>}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="profile-card">
            <div className="profile-title">LOYALTY PROGRESS 🔥</div>
            {myPhone.replace(/\s/g,"").length>=9?(
              <div style={{textAlign:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontFamily:"'Bebas Neue',sans-serif",fontSize:"13px",letterSpacing:"2px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"8px"}}>{loyalty.count}/{LOYALTY_GOAL} QUALIFYING ORDERS</div>
                <div className="loy-big-dots">{Array.from({length:LOYALTY_GOAL}).map((_,i)=><div key={i} className={"loy-big-dot"+(i<loyalty.count?" done":"")}>{i<loyalty.count?"🔥":""}</div>)}</div>
                {loyalty.unlocked?<div style={{fontFamily:"'Bebas Neue',sans-serif",fontSize:"16px",color:"var(--gold)",marginTop:"8px"}}>🏆 FREE COMBO READY TO CLAIM!</div>:<div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",marginTop:"6px"}}>{LOYALTY_GOAL-loyalty.count} more qualifying orders (R50+ subtotal) to earn your FREE Buffalo Wings & Ribs!</div>}
              </div>
            ):<div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",textAlign:"center",padding:"16px 0"}}>Enter your phone number above to view loyalty progress 📱</div>}
          </div>

          <div className="profile-card">
            <div className="profile-title">REFER A FRIEND 🤝</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"12px"}}>Share your code with friends — mention it when ordering to spread the love!</div>
            <div className="referral-box">
              <div className="referral-code">{refCode}</div>
              <div className="referral-sub">Your unique referral code</div>
              <button className="copy-btn" onClick={()=>{ navigator.clipboard?.writeText(refCode); setCopied(true); setTimeout(()=>setCopied(false),2000); }}>{copied?"COPIED! ✓":"COPY CODE"}</button>
            </div>
            <a href={"https://wa.me/?text="+enc("Yo! Order from TAKO! TAKO! — best takos in Ngema Section 🌮🔥\nUse my code "+refCode+" when you order!\nIDLA SOFT DAWG.")} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" style={{textDecoration:"none"}}>
              <button className="obtn" style={{marginTop:"8px",fontSize:"14px",letterSpacing:"2px"}}>📲 SHARE ON WHATSAPP</button>
            </a>
          </div>

          <div className="profile-card">
            <div className="profile-title">ORDER HISTORY 📋</div>
            {myPhone.replace(/\s/g,"").length<9?<div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",textAlign:"center",padding:"16px 0"}}>Enter your phone number above to see your orders 📱</div>:myOrders.length===0?<div style={{fontSize:"11px",color:"var(--gray)",textAlign:"center",padding:"16px 0"}}>No orders found for this number yet.</div>:myOrders.map(([ref,o])=>(
              <div key={ref} className="order-hist-item">
                <div><div className="oh-ref">{ref}</div><div className="oh-info">{o.items.substring(0,40)}{o.items.length>40?"...":""}</div><div className="oh-info">{new Date(o.time).toLocaleDateString()}</div></div>
                <div style={{textAlign:"right"}}><div className="oh-total">R{o.total}</div><div className={"oh-status "+(o.status==="delivered"?"delivered":"pending")}>{o.status==="delivered"?"✓ Done":"⏳ Active"}</div></div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </>}

      <nav className="bottom-nav">
        {navItems.map(n=>(
          <button key={n.id} className={"nav-btn"+(screen===n.id?" on":"")} onClick={()=>{setScreen(n.id);setSubScreen(null);if(n.id==="deals")setNewDeals(0);}}>
            {n.notif>0&&<div className="nav-notif">{n.notif}</div>}
            <span className="ni">{n.icon}</span>
            <span className="nl">{n.label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>

      {selMerch&&(
        <div className="overlay" onClick={()=>setSelMerch(null)}>
          <div className="m-detail-modal" onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            {selMerch.tag&&<div style={{fontFamily:"'Bebas Neue',sans-serif",fontSize:"11px",letterSpacing:"1.5px",background:"linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fire1),var(--fire2))",color:"var(--white)",padding:"3px 10px",borderRadius:"20px",display:"inline-block",marginBottom:"10px"}}>{selMerch.tag}</div>}
            <div className={"m-detail-vis "+(selMerch.color.toLowerCase().includes("cream")||selMerch.color.toLowerCase().includes("bone")||selMerch.color.toLowerCase().includes("white")?"light":selMerch.color.toLowerCase().includes("orange")?"orange":"dark")}>{selMerch.emoji}</div>
            <div className="m-detail-name">{selMerch.name}</div>
            <div className="m-detail-desc">{selMerch.desc}</div>
            <div className="m-detail-color">Color: {selMerch.color}</div>
            {selMerch.sizes.length>1&&<><div style={{fontSize:"9px",fontWeight:"700",textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"2px",color:"var(--gray)",marginBottom:"7px"}}>Select Size</div><div className="size-row">{selMerch.sizes.map(s=><button key={s} className={"sz-btn"+(selSize===s?" on":"")} onClick={()=>setSelSize(s)}>{s}</button>)}</div></>}
            <div className="m-detail-price">R{selMerch.price}</div>
            <button className="m-add-full" disabled={!selSize} onClick={()=>addMerch(selMerch,selSize)}>ADD TO ORDER 🔥</button>
            <button className="bbtn" style={{width:"100%",marginTop:"8px",padding:"12px"}} onClick={()=>setSelMerch(null)}>← Back</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {modal==="order"&&<OrderModal/>}
      {modal==="success"&&curOrder&&<SuccessModal/>}

      {/* ── STAFF PIN MODAL ── */}
      {showPin&&(
        <div className="pin-overlay">
          <div className="pin-box">
            <span className="pin-lock">{pinError?"❌":"🔐"}</span>
            <div className="pin-title">{pinError?"WRONG PIN":"STAFF MODE"}</div>
            <div className="pin-sub">{pinError?"Try again":"Enter your 4-digit PIN to continue"}</div>
            <div className="pin-dots">
              {[0,1,2,3].map(i=><div key={i} className={"pin-dot"+(i<staffPin.length?" filled":"")}/>)}
            </div>
            <div className="pin-pad">
              {[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9].map(n=>(
                <button key={n} className="pin-key" onClick={()=>{ if(staffPin.length<4){ const np=staffPin+n; setStaffPin(np); if(np.length===4){ if(np==="2580"){setShowPin(false);setStaffPin("");setPinError(false);setSubScreen("staff");} else{setPinError(true);setStaffPin("");setTimeout(()=>setPinError(false),2000);} } } }}>{n}</button>
              ))}
              <button className="pin-key zero" onClick={()=>{ if(staffPin.length<4){ const np=staffPin+"0"; setStaffPin(np); if(np.length===4){ if(np==="2580"){setShowPin(false);setStaffPin("");setPinError(false);setSubScreen("staff");} else{setPinError(true);setStaffPin("");setTimeout(()=>setPinError(false),2000);} } } }}>0</button>
              <button className="pin-key del" onClick={()=>setStaffPin(p=>p.slice(0,-1))}>⌫ DEL</button>
            </div>
            <button className="pin-cancel" onClick={()=>{setShowPin(false);setStaffPin("");setPinError(false);}}>Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
    </>
  );
}
